title: Simplify the notice
hook: Two stated cases: explore the explicit reading burden of a form.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the explicit reading burden of a form affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Checks, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the explicit reading burden of a form in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
